purpose: turn a validated opportunity into a plan with scope, order, owners and dates that the team can commit to
entry_criteria: Capacity of the teams is known
Dependencies on other teams are listed
procedure: State the outcome and the measure of success, and what is explicitly out of scope.
Break the work into releasable increments, each delivering value alone.
Order increments by value, risk and dependency, and put the riskiest assumptions earliest.
Estimate with ranges against known capacity, and mark the assumptions behind them.
Name the owner of each increment and each dependency, and agree dates with those teams.
Set review points where scope or order can change, and publish the plan.
deliverables: product plan with scope and out-of-scope
acceptance_criteria: Every increment has an owner and a range estimate
Dependencies are agreed with the other teams

validation.check: check each increment delivers value on its own and has an owner
confirm each external dependency has an agreed date from the other team

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A billing revamp is split into three increments. The one testing the new provider's API comes first because it carries the most risk; estimates are ranges, and the finance team confirms the cut-over window.
